headline: Nevish Line Erupts into Fierce Fighting as Stonecradle Battles Intensify
war_summary: The recent pause along the Nevish Line has shattered violently, erupting into seven strategic base transitions over the past two hours amid fierce clashes around Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father, with hourly losses accelerating past one thousand Wardens and nearly six hundred Colonials. Concurrently, Stonecradle has ignited into active territorial contention, logging six base exchanges across The Reach and World's End alongside mounting casualties. Linn of Mercy maintains intense combat with five fresh transitions recorded between Lathair and Outwich Ranch in the two-hour window. In contrast, base transfers have ceased in Weathered Expanse despite sustained, accelerating fire exchanges. Callahan's Passage persists as a punishing attritional grinder, recording over two thousand casualties in two hours without altering strategic ownership, while rearward sectors continue to report negligible fighting.
